head: codex/5344-v0918-wp12-soak-rollback
title: [v0.91.8][WP-12] Run opt-in soak and prove rollback (#5344)
body:
Closes #5344

## Summary
- retain real native Linux, macOS, and Windows Guardian process-0 qualification for Runtime v3
- prove 10,000 lifecycle cycles, 100 ten-second stress runs, and 10 ten-minute endurance runs per platform with no failed or degraded cycles
- prove isolated ADL v2 installation, locked selector mutation, rollback failure recovery, and exact prior selector-byte restoration
- preserve Runtime v1 and Runtime v2, leave the production default unchanged, and authorize no legacy deletion
- provide the accepted non-deleting cutover handoff for child issue #5343
- parse Git tracked paths as literal NUL-delimited filenames so portable UTF-8 paths do not fail Windows policy checks

## Validation
- manifest-driven WP-12 report verification passed for all three native platform reports
- deterministic rollback replay passed with exact selector restoration
- lifecycle soak tests passed 8/8
- Guardian CLI tests passed 3/3
- Runtime kernel configuration tests passed 20/20
- focused CI path-policy contract passed, including UTF-8, spaces, embedded-newline, and illegal-colon regressions
- final exact-head subagent review passed with zero findings
- typed C-SDLC v2 doctor passed at reviewed generation 24

Provider evidence is a credential-free non-live disposition; no live-provider or demo credit is claimed.
